enchantments.tooltip: Flaming Blast 4: This weapon burns with deadly magical fire, dealing 4d6 Fire damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Fire damage on a critical hit.
Coruscating 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 4d6 Light damage on each hit.

Greater Incineration: This weapon stores the power of a raging inferno deep within. Occasionally, this destructive power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive fire damage. This damage will be dealt more often than a standard Incineration weapon.
